(b) THEN ONE Markdown table consistent with the Lock: - [Source Word] | [Morphology] | [Reference Equivalent] | [Contextual Definition] | [Grammatical Role] Source Text: 7 Tant' è amara che poco è più morte; 8 ma per trattar del ben ch'i' vi trovai, 9 dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte. Reference Translation (provided): So bitter is it that death is little more. But in order to treat of the good that there I found, I will tell of the other things that I have seen there.

**(a) Interpretation Lock – ONE BULLET PER SOURCE LINE**
- **Line 7** – *Tant' è amara che poco è più morte;* **Locked Meaning:** The state described as “bitter” is so intense that the entity **death** (A) is **slightly more** (relation > with degree *slightly*) bitter than the bitterness itself (B).
- **Line 8** – *ma per trattare del ben ch'i' vi trovai,* **Locked Meaning:** The speaker (I) intends **to discuss** (treat) the **good** (G) that the speaker **found** (found) **there** (location = vi).
- **Line 9** – *dirò de l'altre cose ch'i' v'ho scorte.* **Locked Meaning:** The speaker (I) will **tell** (future) about the **other things** (O) that the speaker **has seen** (scorte) **there** (v).
